object_description: single-storey cross-like building of four linked bodies
design_condition: Set on the site alignment with two diagonal public approaches, the extroverted four-part volume creates a main southwestern outdoor space and a northern nursery garden, while leaving the northeastern UAPE extension poorly defined.

positive.statement: The nursery-crèche-UAPE and common premises are clearly identifiable.
The central reception and distribution hall organizes the four entities clearly.
The service volume is pivotally positioned between the entrances and close to the entities it serves.
The sizing of the living spaces is relevant.
The central distribution can be extended and is adequate to the functions and premises it connects.
Overhead lighting initially provides sufficient natural light to the central distribution.
The crossing and bayonet arrangement of the living spaces is skillful and lively.
The supporting-system layout ensures good gravity-load descent and correct spans.
The wall arrangement ensures good overall seismic behavior.

negative.statement: The extroverted implementation does not establish a hierarchy among the exterior spaces.
The UAPE's northeastern external extension is poorly defined.
The peripheral premises are poorly suited to the theme and the proposed arrangement.
The architectural expression provides a rational environment for children rather than a specifically child-oriented one.
The basement and heavy structure on weak soil require consolidation work, significantly increasing the initial or final cost.
Deep foundations are probably necessary for the single-storey building and obligatory for an extension.
